description: Documentation-only hourly-bucket example (D31, calendar periods since D202); no generated backend result. Publication run at the last slot of the 09:00 UTC hour on Saturday 3 October folds the hero's accumulator, expires buckets older than seven days and sums today's and this week's whole-hour buckets.
interval: buckets older than (scoreHour - 168h] expire; xp24h sums buckets from 00:00 UTC of scoreHour's day and xp7d from Monday 00:00 UTC of its week, both up to scoreHour inclusive (D202)
